title: Sharks Are Older Than Trees
hook: Sharks have been swimming for 450 million years, longer than trees have existed.
script: Sharks have been swimming for 450 million years, longer than trees have existed. Back then, nothing on land stood taller than a shrub. A shark grows and sheds thousands of teeth in its lifetime. So what were sharks doing back then? They have survived all five mass extinctions, events that wiped out most life on Earth. They outlived the dinosaurs, which came and vanished long after the first sharks. How does an animal survive that long? Scientists think it is their efficient design, which has barely changed in a very long time.
